witnesses: Chevra Kadisha Rishon LeZion (hkr.org.il, comparison only)
sefaria-daat-siddur-ashkenaz (reader: וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן, then congregation: אמן)
corrections.reason: Metsudah prints "וְאִמְרוּ" in plain type and "אָמֵן" in bold, and bold marks the congregation. The importer therefore gave the word to the congregation only, so the person saying Kaddish would read "וְאִמְרוּ" and stop. In every witness the reciter says "וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן" and the congregation answers "אָמֵן". The reciter keeps the word; the congregation response stays as it is.

witnesses: Birnbaum 1949 (וּמְזוֹנֵי רְוִיחֵי; notes a variant וּמְזוֹנָא רְוִיחָא)
corrections.reason: Metsudah has "וּמְזוֹנָא רְוִיחֵי": a singular noun with a plural adjective. Every witness has the plural pair "וּמְזוֹנֵי רְוִיחֵי"; the singular pair "וּמְזוֹנָא רְוִיחָא" exists as a variant, but the mixed form is not attested.
